# Dart pub hosted registry

<!-- Generated by tools/clientrecipes from src/pub.json; edit the source. -->

Read the [common setup and credential rules](README.md) first. [All recipes](index.md).

Client: **Dart/pub 3.14.0**. Registered classes: **local, remote, virtual, federated**.

Endpoint: `${AW_URL}/artifactory/api/pub/${AW_REPO}`

## Before connecting

- A trusted HTTPS endpoint is required for token authentication.
- Producer and consumer each have their own pubspec.yaml; producer declares a publish_to URL for the selected repository.

Authentication: Use an access token with repository read/write permissions. pub stores the environment variable name and reads AW_TOKEN at runtime; never put a real token in pubspec.yaml.

Fresh client state: Run in a disposable client container with a new /work mount, or a new temporary project directory with all the client home/cache paths below. The acceptance harness uses a new scenario directory and container. Never reuse your normal client home for this check.

## Configure

```sh
export PUB_CACHE="$(mktemp -d)"
export PUB_HOSTED_URL="$AW_URL/artifactory/api/pub/$AW_REPO"
dart pub token add "$PUB_HOSTED_URL" --env-var AW_TOKEN
```

Producer pubspec.yaml: substitute repository variables and include lib/, README.md, CHANGELOG.md and LICENSE.

```yaml
name: hello_pub
version: 1.2.3
description: Example package
environment:
  sdk: ^3.10.0
publish_to: "${AW_URL}/artifactory/api/pub/${AW_REPO}"
```

## Publish

Classes: **local, federated**. Publish only to the classes listed here. A federated recipe proves one-node behavior; remote repositories are read-only client sources.

Run from the producer directory.

```sh
dart pub publish --force
```

## Install or resolve

Classes: **local, remote, virtual, federated**. Use the selected repository key. Virtual resolution requires readable configured members; remote resolution requires an administrator-configured upstream.

Run from a fresh consumer directory whose pubspec.yaml declares hello_pub: ^1.0.0; PUB_HOSTED_URL selects this registry.

```sh
dart pub get
```

## Limits

Classes outside **local, remote, virtual, federated** are not registered for this format. Commands above apply only to each operation's listed classes. Federated evidence is for one node; it does not establish cross-vendor replication.

- Do not use an HTTP endpoint or disable certificate checking for production token use.
- A fresh PUB_CACHE requires adding the environment token reference again.
